a.title: Donald Trump really wants Tim Cook to run Nvidia

b.lede: In a post on Truth Social, President Trump says only one man can take Jensen Huang's place as head of Nvidia: Tim Cook.
b.title: Trump floats Apple chairman Tim Cook as Jensen Huang’s successor
